evidence.expiry: 『biosimilar competition could begin in December 2028 when the primary compound patent expires. The Company also expects to lose market exclusivity in Europe for Keytruda in 2031 following compound patent expiration』→基幹Keytrudaの特許2028崖=期限型独占依存→yes
evidence.moatdecay: 『the Company may not be able to replace sales of successful products that lose patent protection』『If one or more important products lose patent protection in profitable markets, sales of those products are likely to decline significantly as a result of generic or biosimilar versions』+Keytruda2028崖→堀は期限で減衰→yes
evidence.erosion: 『HHS...selected Januvia in 2023 for the first year of the IRA Drug Price Negotiation Program, and selected Janumet and Janumet XR in 2025 for the second year』+China『a new NRDL...new entries averaged approximately 60% price reductions』→既存製品に価格/独占浸食が進行中(ただし基幹Keytruda崖は2028先)→emerging
evidence.disrupt: 蝕/循セクションは技術代替のヒットなし(pricing pressureは価格圧力であって技術破壊でない)→settled
evidence.dom: 『The Company is the only manufacturer in the U.S. of MMRV vaccine (ProQuad) and varicella vaccine (Varivax)』=特定ワクチンの独占ニッチ有。ただし腫瘍免疫は競合(Opdivo等)ありの寡占・全社では大手複数の寡占構造→70。明示的な市場シェア%はhits不記載のため憶測せず寡占帯で評価
evidence.irr: 『Patent protection is considered, in the aggregate, to be of material importance to the Company's marketing of its products』特許有効期間中は代替不能(唯一供給)+FDA承認・データ独占の規格ロック→85(2028以降biosimilar代替可のため100でない)
evidence.rep: 医薬開発は$10B級・十年超の参入障壁だが競合分子は現存(『may not be able to replace sales of successful products that lose patent protection』=追随/biosimilar化あり)→複製不能でなく極困難→80
evidence.dur: 『Patent protection...material importance』特許+FDA規制・データ独占(『twelve years from first marketing approval of a biological product』)+生物製剤製造知=規制/プロセス知型の堀→100(質は最強だが期限型: expiry/moatdecay参照)
evidence.geopol: 『International sales represented 44% and 50% of total sales in 2025 and 2024』+IRA薬価交渉(Januvia/Janumet)+China NRDL約60%減+『In May 2025, the U.S. president...』(MFN/関税等の薬価政策)+基幹Keytruda単一依存(Dec2028崖)=政策/集中リスク重→2
evidence.nrr: 医薬にNRR概念なし・非開示→既定105
evidence.p1: 概算ROIC5年σ≈8pt(2023は買収IPR&Dで約3%へ急落)→σ8pt級=65。外れ値は一過性会計で操業起因でない

evidence.p3: 純負債34.8十億/EBITDA概算≈1.1(<2.5)。ただし2025に$10B買収でdebtL34.5→46.8へ急増しレバレッジ上昇→70
